# Accordion

Collapsible sections on native : open/close works without JS, one-at-a-time via the name attribute unless multiple.

`KenosUI.Accordion` · Data display

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Accordion items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Accordion" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Native <details> sections — no JS needed to open/close.

| `defaultValue` | `string \| string[]` | Open initially. |
